responsibility: Contains the main RTL machine description for the CR16 port. It defines the target’s instruction patterns, expands, unspec codes, mode/code iterators, and output templates for arithmetic, control flow, calls, PIC sequences, and prologue/epilogue-related insns, tying predicates and constraints from the companion .md files to recognizers and final assembly generation so GCC can select and emit concrete CR16 instructions from RTL.
same_name_distinction: This is the RTL machine-description file for CR16, containing define_insn/define_expand patterns, mode/code iterators, unspecs, and assembly templates that drive instruction selection and emission. Unlike cr16.c it does not implement target hooks in C except by calling helper routines, unlike cr16.h it is not a macro configuration header, and unlike cr16.opt it is not an option-specification file.
